description: The Chugoku Electric Power Network grid access page publishes data on the transmission system serving Tottori, Shimane, Okayama, Hiroshima and Yamaguchi prefectures. Since 20 January 2025 expected power flows and available capacity are published together, as PDF tables with CSV data for the bulk system of 220 kV and above and for local systems of 110 kV and below by prefecture (updated on 28 August 2026). Recorded demand and flows are given per substation at hourly resolution for fiscal 2025, with grid configuration diagrams and separate CSV files for transmission lines and transformers for the bulk system and each prefecture, updated on 24 April 2026, with earlier years on an archive page. Further items are the transmission and substation development plan, areas where connecting battery storage at 6.6 kV and above would need major reinforcement, the status of battery connection studies (updated on 25 September 2026), areas where output curtailment may occur in normal times, and medium to long term congestion outlooks for 2029 to 2031 under current and transition scenarios. Coverage is the Chugoku region. Files are free; the operator disclaims responsibility for use of the data and states no licence. Caveats: lines serving a single generating unit are processed for third-party protection, and expected flows are planning estimates. Simulation uses are regional grid models, hosting capacity and congestion analysis, and battery siting. Related records: data-shikoku-td-grid-access-data covers the neighbouring Shikoku area.
